A QUICK GUIDE

Simple records.
Clear decisions.

  1. Add your orders and statement.

    Use the CSV templates in Import center. Amounts are in PKR and times are Pakistan time. Use one statement CSV per receiving account in a saved batch.

  2. Add payment screenshots.

    Enter fields manually, or request Gemini reading after configuring the backend. Cloud reading requires consent. Check amount, date, full reference and payment status against the image, then save. Unconfirmed or unsuccessful evidence remains in Review.

  3. Declare the statement period.

    Use the export's real period, not the time of its first or last transaction. Exact-reference approval also requires you to confirm that sender and receiver IDs correspond.

  4. Reconcile, review and export.

    Ship means a unique match. Hold means not found in the supplied records. Review means you need to check. Whole credits are protected from reuse. In saved batches, explicitly reviewed shares may fund split or combined payments without exceeding the source credit.

Know the limits.

The public demo uses fictional records in this tab. A connected account saves real records on your backend. Gemini can misread; inspect uncertain fields. Credit reuse checks apply to retained allocations. Default batch expiry is seven days; deleting or resetting a batch releases its allocations. This system does not connect to your bank or prove a screenshot is authentic.
